--- a/event_bus.py
+++ b/event_bus.py
@@ -1,2 +1,25 @@
 class EventBus:
-    pass
+    """A simple publish/subscribe event bus."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._subscriptions = {}  # topic -> {subscription_id: handler}
+        self._next_id = 1
+
+    def subscribe(self, topic, handler):
+        """Subscribe handler to topic; returns a unique subscription id."""
+        subscription_id = self._next_id
+        self._next_id += 1
+        self._subscriptions.setdefault(topic, {})[subscription_id] = handler
+        return subscription_id
+
+    def publish(self, topic, payload):
+        """Deliver payload to all handlers subscribed to topic."""
+        for handler in list(self._subscriptions.get(topic, {}).values()):
+            handler(payload)
+
+    def unsubscribe(self, subscription_id):
+        """Remove the subscription with the given id."""
+        for handlers in self._subscriptions.values():
+            if subscription_id in handlers:
+                del handlers[subscription_id]
+                return
